conduct_curriculum_autonomy_008.evidence: Teachers use and adapt resources, technologies, and standards-aligned instructional materials to promote student success in meeting learning goals. Teachers design lessons to meet the needs of diverse learners, adaptingmethods when appropriate.

conduct_lesson_plans_009.evidence: (A) Teachers design clear, well organized, sequential lessons that build on students' prior knowledge. (i) Teachers develop lessons that build coherently toward objectives based on course content, curriculum scope and sequence, and expected student outcomes.
